verdict.reasoning: Rendered PDF page 821 (printed 799) shows Figure E.12 as a flowchart exactly as pdf_says: Condition-1 true/yes and Condition-2 false/yes join a vertical line into 'Evaluate condition-3'; Condition-2 false/no runs straight down to 'Truth value is false'; Condition-3 false/yes and Condition-4 false/yes branch left into that same line; Condition-4 false/no arrows to 'Truth value is true'. The markdown keeps every box label but drops all connectors, and its flattened reading order places 'no' immediately before 'Evaluate condition-3' (and 'yes' before Condition-3/Condition-4 with no target), so the branch topology that is the figure's content cannot be recovered and the text reads as the Condition-2 'no' branch evaluating condition-3, the inverse of the figure. Labels are present, so this is not missing text; it is a lost and misleading figure structure in an informative annex (Annex E), hence real but non-normative.
